headline: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana is expected to reach 1.17M tickets today (range 923K–1.40M), with Friday likely stronger.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has 395K so far; the forecast of 1.17M today (923K–1.40M) comes from how earlier films behaved on release day and day two, so the range is wide.
Its busiest hour still ahead is 9–10 PM at an expected 80.3K (56.9K–106K), after 44.9K (33.8K–50.2K) in 4–5 PM.

Friday is expected to be stronger, with Ramayana at 1.28M (913K–2.00M); the signals lean it +4%, from a 9.4/10 BookMyShow rating (+7%) and critics at 7.5/10 (+3%), offset by the Scene and Mookuthi Amman 2 releases (-2% each).

Jailer 2 (later weeks) has 9.7K so far and is expected at 24.4K today (20.5K–29.3K) and 25.8K tomorrow (19.5K–40.3K), with no review or word-of-mouth information found yet; Aadarsha Kutumbam is expected to peak at 1.8K (1.2K–2.5K) at 10–11 PM, with signals leaning it -7%.
watch: Ramayana's mixed word of mouth and the thin early signals, not yet tested against history, could move these estimates as they fade in over the first 6 hours.
Scene releasing on 6 Nov and Diwali on 2026-11-08 could change tomorrow's numbers.
